info.name: Cloud Export Configuration Cloud Export Admin Service API
info.description:
# Overview
In Kentik, a "cloud export" is an object whose properties are the values that Kentik needs to access network flow logs from a given set of resources in a given cloud provider (see Cloud Exports and Devices).

Contact Support:
 Name: Kentik API Engineering
